## Historical audit: S0184

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/service_incident_01/retired/results/r2/fixed_h0/H0/test/commons_155212263/trajectory.jsonl`. References below are JSONL lines and character ranges in that file’s supplied observations.

| Aspect | Evidence and finding |
|---|---|
| Goal | The student was asked to reconstruct a 512 × 384 indoor RGB scene in Blender using SceneAct, with separate meshes, matching geometry, materials, camera and framing. This is the requested goal, not evidence that it was achieved. The reference image is named but its pixels are not included in the observations (line 1, [0,5609)). |
| Operations and changes | One fresh student CLI session was launched with the staged image; it failed with exit code 1 after approximately 19.3 seconds. The record reports zero tool calls and events, and no student program, scene edit, build, or empty patch is shown (line 2, [0,2613); line 3, [0,538)). |
| Validation and outcome | A model error and then a scene error report the student process exit; the latter traces failure through the initial model request. This is a **technical interruption**, not evidence of an algorithmic reconstruction failure. No render, inspection, score, formal success, or partial-correctness result is visible (lines 3–4, [0,538), [0,1600)). |
| Teacher and exploration | No teacher detection, diagnosis, proposal, execution, or student receipt is recorded. No autonomous exploration is visible beyond the attempted session; zero reported tool calls does not reveal all internal inference activity (line 2, [0,2613)). |
| Scene-specific checks | Multiple objects, materials or textures, connections between parts, pose, and camera, lighting, or render problems cannot be assessed: neither the reference pixels nor a constructed scene or render is visible. The instruction to use separate meshes is not proof that any exist (line 1, [0,5609); lines 2–4). |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, an exited model process should be distinguished from a tested but incorrect scene; validation requires an actual build and render. Task-specifically, camera and material fidelity remain entirely untested here. The stderr path is reported but its contents are not supplied, so the underlying cause of exit 1 is unresolved. No claim about an unseen image, subsequent recovery, or final submission is warranted.
